_doc: StepStone Private Credit Fund LLC anchor dialect (agentA induced, sandboxed, 2026-06-20). Identifiers are PIPE-DELIMITED: 'affil header | secured/instrument type | industry | issuer+instrument | rate token 1 (REF + spread/floor) | rate token 2 (all-in / pik) | maturity'. Goal: give the (none) residual (0.2% of the CIK) a non-empty signature WITHOUT fragmenting the dominant rate-bearing variant (AFFIL REFRATE RATE MAT, 89.1%). The dominant variant already anchors on AFFIL ('Non-Controlled, Non-Affiliated Debt Investments'), REFRATE ('SOFR'), RATE ('n%'), MAT ('m/d/y'); all four are reused from the global STARTER set unchanged.
_doc2: The (none) examples are NOT private-credit positions: CLO warehouses ('Collateralized Loan Obligations | Warehouses | ...'), money-market/treasury cash holdings ('Cash and Cash Equivalents and Restricted Cash ...'), and balance-sheet lines ('Liabilities Less Other Assets', 'Net Assets'). They land in (none) because they carry no AFFIL/REFRATE/RATE/MAT token. Added CLO, CASH, and BALANCE anchors so these gain a non-empty signature and are recognizably non-rate-bearing. These markers do NOT co-occur on the dominant SOFR+rate+maturity debt rows, so they cannot fragment the dominant variant. SECDEBT added for 'First/Second Lien Senior Secured' instrument language and EQUITY/SUBORD for the AFFIL-only fund/equity variant (4.8%) so those keep a stable non-rate signature; neither appears on the floating-loan rate rows. SPREAD/RATE values are PERCENT not bps (5.50% -> twin 0.055). No standalone anchor for tenor ('3M'/'1M') or floor (the second % in token 1): those are within-variant tranche variation folded under REFRATE/RATE and must NOT fragment the signature.

anchors.label: BALANCE
anchors.regex: liabilities less other assets|net assets|other assets

anchors.label: CASH
anchors.regex: cash and cash equivalent|restricted cash|money market|liquidity (?:fund|funds)|treasury portfolio|government fund|other cash accounts

anchors.label: SUBORD
anchors.regex: limited partnership interest|partnership interest|\bfund\b lp|l\.?p\.? fund

anchors.label: EQUITY
anchors.regex: common equity|preferred equity|equity interest|membership interest|preferred stock|common stock|common shares|warrant
